title: Article 39 — Certain principles of policy to be followed by the State

content.overview: Article 39 enumerates policy principles including adequate means of livelihood, distribution of material resources, avoidance of concentration of wealth, equal pay for equal work, protection of workers' health and strength, and opportunities for children. Verify the full clause list in the official text.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: Article 39 is central to economic and social justice policy under Part IV. Individual clauses have informed labour, land reform, and child-protection legislation. Each clause must be read in the official text.

sections.heading: Relation to Article 31C
sections.body: Article 31C refers to laws giving effect to certain Directive Principles; the relationship to Article 39 clauses is a matter of constitutional text and decided cases. Verify before asserting immunity from Articles 14 and 19.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Livelihood and labour claims are typically argued through statute and, where applicable, Article 21 jurisprudence — not by treating Article 39 as directly enforceable.
